ai.headline: Meta broadens AI data use to cover all its AI features, not just one chat
ai.summary: Meta's privacy policy now refers to "our features that are part of AI at Meta" instead of only "AI at Meta," and says content, messages, and interactions with these features are collected and used to provide those features, including creating and understanding content and performing actions. Because the wording covers more features and the policy says these interactions are collected and used, the scope of what Meta treats as AI-related data is wider, though the excerpts do not state whether this data is used to train AI.
